venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Thursday 7/30 (MOD MKZ).** Steady Thursday well over target ($3,545 vs $1,897). Early wave of business with 6 meal deals; wings the #2 food seller. Second wave spiked at 8pm and held to last call — overflow from a Beltline Social Club event at Casi Cielo, plus the Red Bull team came in near close and did a spend. Opening bar handled volume well, garnish cuts looked great, barback knocked out prep then supported the bar. Lots of guest comments about enjoying the experience — 'consistent volume on a little Friday.' Comps $85.10 (manager, community/investor, industry, O4W). Maintenance: 1st bar cooler gasket coming loose. Kitchen managed prep and tickets well.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.weather: Really nice out; good foot traffic later in the evening
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Thursday 7/30 (MOD KE & Chef JMS).** Well short of target ($1,903 vs $3,920). Very slow start — only ~$350 in sales until it picked up at 8pm. Couple of birthday groups (including a 21st), date-night couples, friend groups, and industry visitors (Thomas from O-Ku, Charmers and Fishmonger friends, out-of-town guests getting the full CC Nash experience). Decent food sales ($272) — guests came in hungry; John-Michael strong in BOH and on the floor. Comps $25.10 / 1.3% (DNL, industry, F&F). 86'd coleslaw. No incidents.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Thursday 7/30 (AM Maggie S & Chef Josh / PM Evan & Chef Lucas).** Essentially at target ($11,379 vs $11,400, -0.2%). DC/AM $1,300.90, D&C PM $10,077.92, Garden/6A $2,481.19. Toast rollout continuing smoothly — staff getting the hang of its quirks and compiling notes (chai missing price, egg add-on prompts, open food button/misc sides not sending to kitchen). Garden and lobby steady but never chaotic; smooth service throughout. Kitchen had a chill night with a good pop at the end; Chef Lucas back from vacation. Comps $363.09 (~3.19%). Maintenance: plastic edge around B300 coming off (logged in maintenance channel). No incidents.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Thursday 7/30 (MOD Kyler & Chef Steves).** Just under target ($5,569 vs $5,742, -3%). Mellower Thursday — full bar at open, medium wait by 8pm, then streets went quiet after 10pm; half-full room most of the late night with a 7-top birthday and Rush concert-goers at 1am reviving the energy. Big celebration night: 8 birthdays and 2 anniversaries. Regulars Jim Briggs, Brad Boriello, member Michael Fiardi, and Don Fulano rep Christina Helmer in. Max started server training. Top sellers: Shinebox, Rosalie, Native Lion, Paper Wasp (tied). Comps $76.90. Breakage: footed pils, V martini, Nick & Nora. No no-shows.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Thursday 7/30 (MOD Gigi & Chef Saleh).** Slightly under target ($5,655 vs $6,138, -8%). Sleepy start with the Dodgers game, traction from 8:30pm with a solid rush of resys and walk-ins until 10:30pm, then a dramatic slowdown — no usual Thursday late-night rush, though a group of ~20 came for last-call drinks. Analise's first host training night went great. Kevin Feige was in! Men's restroom door and Marquee paint touch-ups completed pre-service (after cleaning up a spilled paint bucket — teamwork). Kitchen: tons of fries, good oyster movement. Comps $140.40 (DNLs, celebration bubbles). Maintenance: both restroom faucets loose; women's restroom outlet yanked from wall. No-shows charged.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.weather: Overcast, nice breeze — great for foot traffic
venues.narrative: **DC — Thursday 7/30 (MOD Marcus).** Strong night, +31% over target ($6,180 vs $4,715). Much better start than recent nights — filled at 7pm, again at 9pm, and a big late-night pop of larger groups around 11:30pm as Otakon impact began (convention kicks off 7/31; expect a busy weekend). 134 guests (97 walk-in / 37 reso). Sasha began floor/host training; Tyler handled the first rush solo; Mariah took the late push with bar support from Sophia and Ian. Love from an Amazonia group of 5 near last call; 'Team Rocket' came in for a round. Comps $58.84 (community/investor, gift). Maintenance: curtains, warm bulbs for party pod.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Thursday 7/30 (AM Braden & Lex / PM Justin & Marcus/Drew).** Under target ($5,126 vs $6,500, -21%). Splits: Muni Bar AM $553 / PM $3,182, Sun Club $503, Hot Eye $889. Morning: smooth, 16-top food tour at 2pm the highlight; deep-cleaned drains and reorganized storage. Evening: best start of the week with 30 covers; Some Like It Hot played at the Lucas at 7 — good post-9pm walk-in crowd (with Marilyn Monroe lookalikes) that the bar crushed for ~45 minutes. Sun Club steady all day, ~15 Hugo spritzes. Hot Eye slow but steady with a 9pm pop from movie-goers and business groups; done by midnight. Guests 45 AM / 120 PM. Comps $124. Maintenance: Hot Eye dishwasher breaker issue, room was locked. No incidents.
